UPDATE.description: Whether to automatically update the initramfs when a new kernel is installed. Set to 'yes' for automatic updates, 'no' to disable (manual update required).

BACKUP.description: Whether to create a backup copy of the existing initramfs before replacing it. Valid values: '1' (true, backup enabled) or '0' (false, no backup).

HOOKS.description: Comma-separated list of initramfs hooks to *explicitly* enable. Leave empty to use the system's default set of hooks. Example: 'lvm2,mdadm' (without quotes).

MODULES.description: Comma-separated list of kernel modules to forcibly include in the initramfs, beyond those auto-detected. Leave empty for auto-detection only. Example: 'ahci,usb_storage'.

COMPRESS.description: Compression algorithm to use for the initramfs. Common options: 'gzip', 'lzma', 'zstd', 'xz'. Use empty string to use the system default (set via initramfs-tools config).

BOOTDIR.description: Directory where initramfs images are stored (e.g., '/boot'). Must exist and be writable by root.

ARCH.description: Comma-separated list of target architectures for which to generate initramfs. Leave empty to build for the current architecture only. Example: 'amd64,i386'.

VERBOSE.description: Enable verbose logging during initramfs generation. Set to '1' for detailed output, '0' for quiet operation.
